headline: Google's Gemini 3.8 Live Update Adds Real-Time Animated Avatars
summary: Google's Gemini 3.8 Live now features 'Live Avatar' that lip-syncs and shows expressions, but it's currently exclusive to Enterprise customers.
details: Google has launched an update for its Gemini AI model, version 3.8 Live, which introduces a 'Live Avatar' feature. This new capability allows users to interact with an animated AI persona that responds in real-time, complete with lip-syncing and facial expressions.

The Live Avatar is designed to enhance user interaction by providing a visual representation of the AI. It supports seamless transitions between 97 languages without compromising video quality or introducing visual drift, as demonstrated in a Google video showcasing English and Japanese conversations.

Beyond just conversation, the Live Avatar can also display relevant information on-screen while it communicates. This feature aims to make AI interactions more dynamic and informative, potentially for customer service or virtual assistance applications.

This update follows the recent announcement of the Gemini 3.8 Live model, which boasts near real-time processing of visual inputs. While Google will offer a selection of pre-designed avatars, organizations will also have the option to create their own custom avatars.

Google has stated that the output from Live Avatar includes an invisible SynthID watermark and incorporates safeguards to protect identity. The feature is currently only available to Gemini Enterprise customers, with no immediate plans for wider release announced.
